:::{#cor-p-neg}
#### Complement rule in probability ($\prob$) notation

If the probability of an event $A$ is $\Pr(A)=\prob$,
then the probability that $A$ does not occur is:

$$\Pr(\neg A)= 1 - \prob$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
\Pr(\neg A) &= 1 - \Pr(A)
&& \text{(complement rule)} \\
&= 1 - \prob
&& \text{(substitute } \Pr(A) = \prob \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
